children: The Emperor's Shadow Guard is a new fighting force based on Emperor Palpatine's elite

. Completely mute and rarely seen in public, they are dispatched on special missions as directed by the Emperor himself. It is rumored by some that the Shadow Guard are actually corrupted Jedi whose minds have been altered- but as with all rumors, one must consider the source.

The Shadow Guard wears a black variation of the Royal Guard Armor, the most apparent difference being the color scheme. The Shadow Guard's greatest secret is that they receive some basic Force training that enables them to use a unique weapon called a
blade at one end. (The statistics below reflect those of a Shadow Guard Initiate who has just begun their secret training.)
